Balaji Amines Limited is a prominent Indian chemical manufacturing company headquartered at 165-A, Railway Lines, Solapur - 413001, Maharashtra, India. The company is widely recognized for its strong presence in the specialty chemicals and aliphatic amines segment, serving a broad range of industries both in India and international markets. Over the years, Balaji Amines Limited has built a reputation for reliability, product quality, technical expertise, and continuous innovation in chemical manufacturing.

The company is primarily engaged in the production of methylamines, ethylamines, derivatives of specialty chemicals, and pharmaceutical excipients, which are important raw materials and intermediates for several downstream industries. Its products find applications in pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, water treatment, rubber chemicals, dyes, personal care products, and other industrial sectors. This diversified application base has helped the company maintain a strong market position and adapt to changing industrial demand.

Balaji Amines Limited is known for its emphasis on integrated manufacturing operations, process efficiency, and a customer-focused approach. With modern production facilities, an experienced technical team, and a commitment to high manufacturing standards, the company has developed the capability to supply both bulk and value-added chemical products. It also places importance on research and development to improve product quality, expand its portfolio, and meet evolving customer requirements.

In addition to its manufacturing strength, the company reflects the growth of India’s chemical industry by combining industrial scale with innovation and operational discipline. From its base in Solapur, Maharashtra, Balaji Amines Limited continues to contribute significantly to the chemical sector through quality products, dependable supply, and a forward-looking business strategy.
